title: Monthly Management Fee Invoicing under the Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
A site running under the Workplace Cafe Management Program is billed in cycles, and each billing period on a workplace cafe management contract brings the contract's management fee for that period into charge. The client's workplace experience manager expects, for the month just served, a management fee standing on the contract under a printed invoice number they can settle against.

The management fee for a billing period is not worked out before the service model standing on the contract is the one named on the contract's approved change of service model.

## What the desk puts in place

The management fee for the billing period is charged on the contract. The charge is booked onto that contract's ledger against the billing period it covers, dated the day it is raised, and carries its own printed invoice number; the contract's unsettled invoice balance stands higher by the amount charged. From the client's side, a management fee charge for that period is then visible on the contract with a number to pay against.

## The function at the desk, and what it proves

One function books that charge on the contract. What it establishes is that a management fee posting of the amount given stands on the contract's ledger against the billing period named, dated the day of the call, under its own printed invoice number, and that the contract's unsettled invoice balance has risen by the same amount.

## How it is invoked

The function `raise_management_fee_invoice_00d6d0cf` is unlocked for the client services agent holding the contract, who runs it against that contract.

## What it takes

- `cafe_contract_id` — the reference number of the workplace cafe management contract being invoiced, given in the identifier form the contract carries.
- `amount_usd` — the management fee being charged for the billing period, in USD, written as a decimal number to 2 decimal places; it is stored to 2 decimal places exactly as given.
- `service_period` — the billing period the management fee covers, written as a calendar month in the form YYYY-MM with no day part.

## What comes back

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, naming the contract reference invoiced, the management fee amount in USD to 2 decimal places, the billing period covered, the posting day as YYYY-MM-DD, and the printed invoice number of the new posting in the form INV-CF- followed by 6 digits. That invoice number is the reference quoted on anything raised against this invoice, and receiving the sentence is what shows the invoice stands on the contract.
